_note: `bind:value` is a `"bind:value": EXPR` attribute of the element, and `svelte/elements` types it `any` on every element, so no mismatch between the bound target and the input's `type=` is reported — upstream reports nothing on these components. An earlier version derived a target type from the literal `type=` attribute and asserted the bound expression against it, inventing TS2322 here.
